title: Total degree of a multivariate Hermite polynomial
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a multi-index $\alpha\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb{N}$, the total degree of the product of normalized Hermite polynomials with coordinate degrees $\alpha_i$ is $\sum_{i=1}^n\alpha_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns a natural number to each of the $n$ coordinates
